checkpoint.name: fixed12
checkpoint.selection: Original minimum trained-count validation CE; same architecture as fixed6

definitions.forced: Ignore stopping and evaluate C through supplied N.
definitions.exact: First stop probability >=0.5 occurs at N; no cap fallback success.
definitions.joint: Exact stop and returned C letter matches x_N; earlier mistakes permitted.
definitions.strict: Exact stop and every intermediate C letter is correct.
definitions.intervals: Pointwise 95% Wilson across graphs at each separately prompted N.
